editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FXCM is a legitimate Tier-1 regulated broker scoring 6.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. Operating since 1999 with FCA, CySEC, and ASIC licences, it offers genuine execution transparency and powerful algo trading tools via Trading Station. But the regulatory history — a £4M FCA fine for withholding client profits and a CFTC ban from the US market — permanently shadows its credibility. Standard account pricing at 1.3 pips is expensive. Active Trader pricing at 0.2 pips is excellent but requires $25,000. For the algo trader with capital who values execution data and automation tools, FXCM delivers real value. For everyone else, cheaper and cleaner options exist.
